title: Source comparison for generator pullback restrictions
statement: For schemes X,Y, f:Y→X and an etale arrow i:V→W over X [def-pc-scheme], set P_U=U×_X Y with projections p_U,q_U and j=b(i). Let c(a,b;h) be the canonical composition comparison for module pullback [def-pc-module-pullback], and let K(M):j*p_W*M ≅ p_V*i*M be the canonical comparison of the commuting projection square. The explicit source factor A_U:q_U*O_Y ≅ p_U*U*O_X of [lem-sc-etale-generators-pullback-section] satisfies c(j,q_W;q_V,O_Y).inv ≫ j*A_W.hom ≫ K(W*O_X).hom = A_V.hom ≫ p_V*c(i,W;V,O_X).inv.

proof.text: Prove private unitComparison_app_unit directly from SheafOfModules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction_homEquiv_pullbackObjUnitToUnit and Adjunction.homEquiv_unit. For every section r this identifies U(f)(eta_f(r)) with f.app(r). Prove private unitComparison_comp by pullback_hom_ext: pullbackUnit_comp_app_apply and pullbackUnit_naturality_apply reduce its two sides to the structure-sheaf maps of the composite, which agree by Scheme.Hom.comp_app. These library lemmas are already proved; this uses no tensor pullback construction or generator theorem.

Transport the composition identity along a specified equality of scheme morphisms (unitComparison_compOfEq), and cancel the inverse comparison to obtain unitComparison_compOfEq_hom. The private unitComparison_square follows by applying the inverse composition identity on one path and the forward identity on the other path of the commuting square. The square comparison is explicitly their composite, so the middle structure-module comparison agrees without invoking three-fold pseudofunctor associativity.

In the proved private unitComparison_source, postcompose the expanded source-factor identity by p_V* of c(i,W;V).hom, then p_V*U(V).hom and U(p_V).hom; all are isomorphisms. On the right, inverse/hom cancellation yields U(q_V). On the left, the forward composition identity for i,W,V replaces the first two postcomposition factors by p_V*i*U(W).hom followed by p_V*U(i).hom. Naturality of the square comparison moves U(W) to the j*p_W side, cancelling its inverse. Apply unitComparison_square and cancel U(p_W) with its inverse. The inverse composition law for j,q_W,q_V gives U(q_V). Specialize this proved calculation to the etale pullback square using Over.pullback_map_left and the over-category commutativity proofs.

theorem etaleGeneratorsPullbackSource_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    {V W : X.Etale} (i : V ⟶ W) :
    (pullbackCompOfEq ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).left
      (Limits.pullback.snd W.hom f) (Limits.pullback.snd V.hom f)
      ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).w (unit Y)).inv ≫ (pullback
        ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ f).map i).left).map
        (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSourceIso f W).hom ≫
      (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSquareIso f i ((pullback W.hom).obj (unit X))).hom =
      (etaleGeneratorsPullbackSourceIso f V).hom ≫
        (pullback (Limits.pullback.fst V.hom f)).map (pullbackCompOfEq i.left W.hom V.hom i.w
          (unit X)).inv
